scope.novelty: Clinical treatment trolley with instrument top, side rails, waste-holder and caster chassis; not library book trolley or plain tool cabinet.
Examination couch with sectional reclining back, step and paper-roll holder; distinct from wheeled hospital bed/stretcher.
Lockable shallow medicine wall cabinet with glass doors, adjustable interior and divided bins; not generic office filing cabinet.
Fixed upholstered restaurant banquette with high back and plinth/end panel; not living-room sofa or repeated chairs.
Shallow pond basin with shoreline rim, independent water surface and bank module; not puddle plane or fountain.
Hotel shell with lobby setback, drop-off, repetitive guestroom bays and service core; no duplicated room-bed counts.
Hospital shell with public/ambulance entrance separation, low diagnostic podium and ward wing; not generic tower recolour.
Enclosed community centre with multipurpose hall volume, smaller activity rooms and foyer; not open HDB pavilion.
Police station shell with public entrance, recessed reception bay and separate service/custody-side access represented generically; no real security plan.
Fire station with multiple tall appliance bays, office side-wing and apron; incorporates existing single vehicle-bay component without recounting.
Factory shell with production hall, roof ventilation/clerestory and service/loading wing; distinct from warehouse rack shed.
Corner convenience-store shell with recessed entrance, shop glazing and rear stockroom; not extra counts for copied retail shelves.
Hospital corridor module with room openings, handrails, wall-protection rails and service-ceiling bays; not mall/HDB corridor reskin.
Independent compact hotel wet-room with shower enclosure, wet/dry zoning and editable sanitary assemblies; one room asset, not extra counts for reused sink.
Original panel van with sliding side access and double rear doors/cargo floor; not passenger hatchback stretched.
Ambulance body with distinctive high patient compartment, rear double doors and interior stretcher restraint concept; no medical functionality or real branding.
School bus with high-floor passenger rows, emergency exit and school-access step arrangement; not public city bus colour variant.
